confidence_notes: Low overall. Restaurant anchors rest on one aggregator (combien-coute.net, Alanya cost-of-living and lunch pages, indicative 2026 estimates in EUR) converted to USD at approximate rates, so they are medium-low. Beer uses Expatistan crowd-sourced Antalya pub and supermarket figures, one from 2025, and is adjusted upward for Alanya tourist-venue pricing. Cocktail and wine_glass are not directly sourced; cocktail is set at about 2.3x beer and wine_glass at about 1.3x beer, per the instruction to use the local beer relationship, because the cocktail and wine searches failed with rate limits. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for peak July season, not checked against live listings or booking pages. FX: the only RBA observation I could retrieve is a cached snapshot dated 2026-03-20 (USD 0.7088, RBA quote in USD per AUD). I could not verify a more recent observation for the 2026-10-16 generation date, so the FX value is likely stale.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basis is Turkish Mediterranean resort pricing (Alanya and the Antalya coast) with Antalya beer data as the closest local reference. Turkey is classified as Middle East under the UN M49 Western Asia grouping; the Mediterranean resort context is also comparable to lower-cost southern European resort towns. No other city was used as a direct comparator.
